facts.claim: ADD0 tied to ground selects seven-bit I2C address 0x48.
Register data is transferred most significant byte first.
Temperature is signed 16-bit two's-complement with 1/128 degree Celsius per LSB; reset temperature word is 0x8000.
Factory-default configuration reset is 0x0220; Data_Ready bit 13, MOD bits 11:10, AVG bits 6:5. EEPROM-programmed configuration may change the power-up value.
MOD 01 selects shutdown, MOD 11 selects one-shot, AVG 00 disables averaging.
Conversion completion sets Data_Ready; reading configuration or temperature clears it.
One-shot completes then returns to shutdown; CONV bits do not control one-shot conversion time.
Single conversion timing is 13 ms minimum, 15.5 ms typical, 17.5 ms maximum.
Device ID lower 12 bits are 0x117; upper 4 bits represent revision.

derived_candidates.derivation: From reset 0220, clear MOD mask 0C00 and AVG mask 0060; select shutdown 0400 or one-shot 0C00. Preserve CONV bits. Validate with the source before approval.

model_limits: No electrical waveform or bus arbitration model
No continuous mode or averaging support
